QuestInfo.name: [Red Leaf High] Mission: Ghost in the Staff Room
QuestInfo.1: The troublesome ghosts who didn't want to hear the morning announcements of the Headmaster had finally hidden the Assembly Microphone somewhere in the Staff Room again. You are also bored with the announcements made by the Headmaster but since it is request of the Homeroom Teacher #p9000127#, you cannot help but to go look for the #bAssembly Microphone#k in the Staff Room.
QuestInfo.2: The troublesome ghosts who didn't want to hear the Headmaster's morning announcements had hidden the Assembly Microphone somewhere in the Staff Room again. You're bored with the announcements too, but since the Homeroom Teacher, #p9000127#, asked you to go find the #bAssembly Microphone#k in the Staff Room, you had to.
